how_to_apply: Despite the term "apply online" being commonly searched, AIIMS Patna is not accepting online applications for this recruitment. Candidates can apply only through offline mode, using the prescribed application form enclosed with the official advertisement. The steps are:
Download or obtain the prescribed application form from the official notification.
Fill in personal details, educational qualifications, and work experience in capital letters as instructed.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph and sign the declaration.
Report in person on any one of the walk-in interview dates (05.09.2026, 12.09.2026, 19.09.2026 or 26.09.2026) between 10:00 AM and 01:00 PM at the Committee Room, Admin Building, AIIMS Patna.
Carry the filled form along with all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies for verification.
No candidate will be allowed to appear for the interview after the stipulated reporting time.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or for joining the post. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. If any information furnished by the candidate is found false, incorrect, or suppressed, the candidature/appointment is liable to cancellation/termination. The appointment is purely contractual/temporary and does not confer any right to permanent absorption or regular appointment. The appointment is full-time; private practice of any kind is not permitted during the tenure of engagement. Selection/appointment is subject to medical fitness certified by the Medical Board constituted/authorized by AIIMS Patna. Selected candidates may join only after being declared medically fit. The selected candidate must submit an undertaking at the time of joining, agreeing to tender resignation if required by the Institute at any stage. The Institute reserves the right to reject any or all applications and to cancel or modify the recruitment process, subject to applicable rules. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts at Patna, Bihar. Candidates are advised to regularly check the official AIIMS Patna website for updates, corrigendum, addendum, or further instructions. Current status of vacant seats will be uploaded on the Institute website at least two (2) days before each interview date.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Vacancy 2026 - Department-wise Posts
AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must possess the prescribed postgraduate qualification in the concerned specialty/discipline from a recognized University or Institute. The candidate must be registered with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or State Medical Council, wherever applicable. The candidate should fulfil all eligibility conditions prescribed under the applicable Residency Scheme. Candidates already working in any Government or Autonomous Institution must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview/document verification. The required postgraduate qualification differs by department. Key examples include: Anatomy: MD/DNB in Anatomy Anaesthesiology, Pain Medicine & Critical Care: MD/DNB in Anaesthesiology Orthopaedics: MS/DNB in Orthopaedics Ophthalmology: MS/DNB in Ophthalmology Obstetrics & Gynaecology: MD/MS/DNB in Obstetrics & Gynaecology General Medicine: MD/DNB in General Medicine General Surgery: MD/DNB in General Surgery For the full department-wise qualification list, candidates should refer to the official notification, as each of the 16 departments has its own specified MD/MS/DNB requirement.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for eligibility is 45 years as on 31.08.2026. Candidates who have already completed the maximum permissible period of Senior Residency under the applicable Residency Scheme are not eligible. Applicants must also pass the qualifying examination on or before 31st July 2026 and be able to furnish proof of this by the same date. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

rows.age_relaxation: No relaxation (upper age limit as on 31.08.2026 is 45 years)

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Patna Senior Resident 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Selected Senior Residents will be paid as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC), Level-11 of the pay matrix (pre-revised PB-3), with an entry pay of Rs. 67,700 per month, plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) and other allowances as admissible under Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Verification of eligibility and original documents. Selection based on performance in the walk-in interview, subject to fulfilment of prescribed eligibility criteria, document verification and applicable reservation rules. In case two or more candidates secure equal marks, the candidate older in age (earlier date of birth) will be placed higher in the merit list. Performance in the interview and/or any other selection process, as decided by the Competent Authority. The list of selected candidates will be uploaded on the official AIIMS Patna website. The decision of the Competent Authority/Selection Committee is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Reservation and PwBD Criteria
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS is applicable as per Government of India policy. Candidates applying under EWS/OBC/SC/ST categories must possess a valid category certificate issued by the competent authority, valid for admission/employment in Central Government Institutions, issued on or before the date of interview. For OBC/EWS candidates, the certificate must have been issued during Financial Year 2026-27. In the absence of a valid reserved-category certificate, a candidate may be considered against an Unreserved (UR) vacancy, provided the post is advertised under the UR category and the candidate meets all UR eligibility criteria. Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) is applicable on a horizontal basis within respective categories. The disability certificate must be issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of a State or Central Government Hospital/Institution and countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital/Institution.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for AIIMS Patna Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the following documents in original, along with one set of self-attested photocopies: Duly filled application form Recent passport-size photographs Proof of date of birth Valid photo identity proof Class 10th and 12th certificates and mark sheets MBBS/BDS/M.Sc degree and mark sheets, as applicable Postgraduate degree/diploma/DNB/DM/M.Ch/Ph.D certificates, as applicable Valid registration certificate with NMC/State Medical Council, wherever applicable Internship/experience certificates, if applicable Caste/Category certificate in the prescribed format Valid OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate/EWS certificate, wherever applicable PwBD certificate, wherever applicable No Objection Certificate (NOC), if employed in any Government/Autonomous Institution Publications and other relevant documents, if any Candidates failing to produce the required original documents at the time of verification may not be considered for interview/selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 68 vacancies across 16 departments, including Anaesthesiology, General Medicine, General Surgery, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics and others.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted only in offline mode, using the prescribed application form enclosed with the official notification. There is no online application process for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on 31.08.2026, with relaxation of up to 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and up to 10–15 years for PwBD candidates depending on category.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at AIIMS Patna?
faq.answer: Senior Residents are paid as per 7th CPC Level-11 of the pay matrix, with an entry pay of Rs. 67,700 per month, plus NPA and other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q5. What is the tenure of the Senior Resident post at AIIMS Patna?
faq.answer: The engagement is for a period of 89 days or until the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. Continuation or renewal, wherever permissible, depends on Institute requirements and performance.

faq.question: Q6. When and where is the AIIMS Patna Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are held on 05.09.2026, 12.09.2026, 19.09.2026 and 26.09.2026, from 10:00 AM to 01:00 PM, at the Committee Room, Admin Building, AIIMS Patna.
